imp.generic: The city was busy and indifferent to the people moving through it.
imp.author: The city went about its business the way it always did, which was without any interest in yours.

imp.generic: She was an attractive woman who seemed to be hiding something.
imp.author: She was the kind of pretty that comes with fine print, and I hadn't read it yet.

imp.generic: It was late at night and the streets were mostly empty.
imp.author: It was past midnight and the streets had given up on people, which was a reasonable position to take.

imp.generic: He felt tired and discouraged after a long period without success.
imp.author: I had the kind of tired that sleep doesn't fix and the kind of discouraged that a drink only postpones, and I was working on postponing it.

imp.generic: The man was wealthy but dishonest, and his money showed it.
imp.author: He had the kind of money that doesn't stay clean no matter how many times you launder it, and the kind of face that knew it.

imp.generic: The bar was a rough, unpleasant place frequented by dangerous people.
imp.author: The bar was the kind of establishment that doesn't bother with a sign because the people who need to find it always do, and the people who don't need to find it are better off lost.

imp.generic: He opened the door and immediately sensed that something was wrong.
imp.author: The door swung open and the room told me everything I needed to know in the first half second, which was that I was already too late and probably too sober.

imp.generic: She said she loved him, but her expression suggested otherwise.
imp.author: She said she loved him the way people say they're fine when they're sitting in the wreckage, and her eyes didn't bother to agree with her mouth.

imp.generic: The case was over, but he didn't feel any sense of satisfaction.
imp.author: It was finished, the way things finish in this business, which is to say badly and without applause and with just enough loose ends left over to keep a man awake at three in the morning staring at a ceiling that doesn't have any answers either.

imp.generic: The detective's office was small and located in a part of town that had declined over the years.
imp.author: The office was two flights up in a building that had once had ambitions and had since made its peace with disappointment, which put it in good company with everyone who rented space in it.
